question: Round 6, ideas from the momentum and swing-trading research (README: 'Round 6 sources'). Company evaluation: closeness to the 52-week high, a steady climb, the market's 3-day reaction to the last report (alone and with the earnings surprise), and gross-margin trend. Entries: a real tight-base pivot breakout (VCP), the earnings-gap entry (episodic pivot), and buying at the close instead of the open. Risk: scaling buys down when the market is volatile. Each alone against the live rules, then on top of cap98_tight (the tournament challenger). Fundamentals variants run against their has-data twin.

variants.name: v_whigh30
variants.why: add closeness to the 52-week high to the rank

variants.name: hd_sue0_ear0
variants.why: earnings surprise AND a positive market reaction (Brandt et al.)

variants.name: ct_base
variants.why: cap98_tight, the tournament challenger, repeated in this run

variants.name: hd_base
variants.why: has-data twin for the fundamentals variants below

variants.name: v_smooth05
variants.why: only steady climbers: more up days than down over 12-1 months (frog in the pan)

variants.name: v_ear3
variants.why: only names that beat SPY by 3%+ around their last report

variants.name: v_high90
variants.why: only names within 10% of their 52-week high (George & Hwang)

variants.name: ct_ear0
variants.why: cap98_tight + rewarded at the last report

variants.name: hd_margin0
variants.why: gross margin at least a year ago's

variants.name: r_vol15
variants.why: scale buys down when SPY's 20-day volatility is above 15%

variants.name: e_ep
variants.why: buy only within 5 sessions of an earnings gap of 4%+ on 2x volume that is holding (episodic pivot)

variants.name: v_ear0
variants.why: only names the market rewarded at their last report (3-day return over SPY >= 0)

variants.name: e_vcp
variants.why: buy only a close above the 10-day pivot out of a tight base on rising volume (Minervini VCP)

variants.name: e_close
variants.why: buy at the signal day's close instead of the next open (momentum returns accrue overnight)
